params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to retrieve business hours for.

items.docs: Returns opening and closing hours from Monday to Sunday for the specified location.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to change business hours for.

items.docs:
Modifies the existing business hours for the specified location.
Send this request [GET /locations/{locationId}/businesshours](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/AfterHours/GETv3_locations__locationId__businesshours) to get the location business hours.
Learn [how to manage business hours](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/683409418/Managing+Business+Hours+and+Holidays+for+a+Location) in ServiceChannel University.
**Examp

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to retrieve holidays for.

items.docs: Returns the details of each holiday for the specified location.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier of the subscriber’s location you want to add or update holidays for.

items.docs:
Adds a holiday to the specified location.
Send this request [GET /locations/{locationId}/holidays](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/AfterHours/GETv3_locations__locationId__holidays) to get the location holidays.
Learn [how to manage holidays for a location](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/683409418/Managing+Business+Hours+and+Holidays+for+a+Location) in ServiceChannel University.
**Example Request**

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier of the location to delete a holiday from.

params.name: holidayName
params.description: The name of the holiday you want to remove.

items.docs: Permanently removes a holiday from the specified location.
